About AMIA Studios

A Calmer Kind of Chair.

AMIA Hair Studios sits inside Queensgate Centre in Grays — a specialist afro hair salon for clients across Thurrock, Tilbury, Stanford-le-Hope, Basildon and Dartford.

We work with every texture, from a once-a-month silk press to a fresh set of knotless braids, a loc retwist, or a meticulous wig install.

The work is built on three quiet principles: low tension, scalp-first technique, and a beautiful finish.
